answer: We establish a rigorous defense of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments and verifiable delay primitives, a voyage of cryptographic innovation that illuminates the whisper of computational hardness against identity cloning. By leveraging sequential delay functions, an adversary attempting to forge an identity would need to concurrently execute a sequence of computationally infeasible tasks, thereby extinguishing the ember of feasibility, ultimately rendering the attack computationally infeasible.
